carucage.definition:
n. A tax on every plow or plowland.
n. The act of plowing.
carucage.translation: n. (旧时英国的)犁头税, 每一卡勒凯特的土地税

carucate.definition:
n. A plowland; as much land as one team can plow in a year
   and a day; -- by some said to be about 100 acres.
carucate.translation: n. 卡勒凯特(旧时英国的土地丈量和估税单位,约合100英亩,但常据土质而不同)

carucates.definition:

   and a day; -- by some said to be about 100 acres.
carucates.translation: (carucate 的复数) n.卡勒凯特(旧时英国的土地丈量和估税单位,约合100英亩,但常据土质而不同)
